mass_balance.note: D is modeled demand, W is the measured CINGSA inventory draw. What falls out of P is field production plus any Hilcorp storage draw combined, which is why the field is named non_cingsa_supply_mmcfd and is never called production.

derived.days_cover_note: Inventory divided by modeled peak demand. It is arithmetic on storage alone and takes no account of the withdrawal capacity ceiling, field supply, or deliverability. It is not a measure of adequacy.

reconciliation.basis: observed HDD from ACIS PANC, measured inventory draw from the CINGSA record committed for that date

model.calibration: fitted to observed EIA Alaska deliveries; the published design day and average day are kept as external reference points, not as fit targets
